data.one_liner: On-device bank card scanner using native OCR without third-party camera plugins.
data.what_it_does: Scans payment cards using the device camera or static images to extract card numbers, expiry dates, and cardholder names. Recognition runs fully on-device via native platform OCR engines (Vision, ML Kit, and PaddleOCR for Web).
use_when: You need to scan credit or debit cards on iOS, Android, and Web.
You require on-device privacy with zero cloud services or network access.
avoid_when: You are targeting environments where the 51MB web OCR asset installation is problematic.
strengths: Full on-device privacy with multiple card brand support.
Customizable UI and flexible field requirements.
weaknesses: Requires a manual web installation step (51MB of models/runtimes for the web).
Web assembly can run significantly slower on certain older or specific browser versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires camera usage description in iOS Info.plist. For web deployments, you must run the dart run flutter_card_scanner_plus:install_web installer command.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard barcode or QR code scanning instead of full credit card OCR.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want low-level control over the camera stream to build your own custom computer vision pipeline.
